description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'KpiSearchFilterParams' used for filtering KPI search results in the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends a base filter parameters class and provides properties and methods related to job title filtering and sorting.

classes.name: KpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters for KPI queries, including sorting options and job title filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID used as a filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID to filter KPI search results.
